			const parseJwtOauth = function(token){
				var base64Url = token.split('.')[1];
				var base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
				var jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(window.atob(base64).split('').map(function(c) {
					return '%' + ('00' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2);
				}).join(''));
				return JSON.parse(jsonPayload);
			}
			const identity =  parseJwtOauth(document.cookie.split("; ").find((row) => row.startsWith("access_token="))?.split("=")[1]);
			oauthSession = (identity.identityType == "R" && identity.storeId == 94009000); // con usuario registrado en esta store
		}
	} catch(e) { console.error("Error checking oauth session", e); }

  font-size: min(30px, calc((30 * 100vw) / 2560));
  line-height: 1;
}
    
    
@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .big-banner.lft-cover.Tiendas_v25 .cover-info-wrapper {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column-reverse;
    }

    .big-banner.lft-cover.Tiendas_v25 .download-app-svg {
      margin: 56px auto 30px auto;
      width: min(420px, calc((420 * 100vw) / 582));
      display:block;
    }

    .big-banner.lft-cover.Tiendas_v25 .cover-info {
      text-align: center;
      padding-top: 0;
    }

    .big-banner.lft-cover.Tiendas_v25 .cover-info .cover-texts {
      padding-top: 30px;
      padding-left: 0;
      border-left: none;
    }

    .big-banner.lft-cover.Tiendas_v25 .cover-info .cover-texts::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left:0; 
      right:0;
      margin-left:auto; 
      margin-right: auto;
      width: min(146px, calc((146 * 100vw) / 582));
      height: 1px;
      background: white;      
    }

    .big-banner.lft-cover.Tiendas_v25 .pretitle {
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: min(20px, calc((20 * 100vw) / 582));
      line-height: min(33px, calc((33 * 100vw) / 582));
      padding-bottom: 0;
    }
    .big-banner.lft-cover.Tiendas_v25 .title {
      font-weight: 300;
      font-size: min(25px, calc((25 * 100vw) / 582));
      line-height: min(33px, calc((33 * 100vw) / 582));
      padding-bottom: calc((20 * 100vw) / 582);
    } 
    .big-banner.lft-cover.Tiendas_v25 .subtitle {
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: min(20px, calc((20 * 100vw) / 582));
      line-height: 1;
    }  
    .big-banner.lft-cover.Tiendas_v25 .banner-text-disclaimer {
      padding-bottom: calc((25 * 100vw) / 390);
    }
    .big-banner.lft-cover.Tiendas_v25 .button-wrapper {
      display:none;
    }
}

		createCovers: function(_dataJSON){
			universalAnalytics.sendInitialPageviewByiPageName();

			this.checkColorThemeScroll  = _.throttle(this.checkColorTheme.bind(this), 20);
			$(window).on('scroll', this.checkColorThemeScroll);

			this.coversObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
				function(_entries){ 
					_entries.forEach(function(_entry){
						if($(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video:not(.transparent)').length > 0){
							if(_entry.isIntersecting){
								$(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video:not(.transparent)').each(function(_index, _cover){
									if($(_cover).attr('loaded') == null){
										$(_cover).attr('loaded', true);										

										let hls = null;
										if(Hls.isSupported() && $(_cover).attr('data-src').indexOf(".mp4?") == -1){
											hls = new Hls();
											hls.loadSource($(_cover).attr('data-src'));
											hls.attachMedia(_cover);
										} else {
											$(_cover).attr('src', $(_cover).attr('data-src'))
										}

										// si es video animacion, el video se hace visible con el hover 
										let li = _entry.target.closest("li.video-animation");
										if(!li) { $(_cover).css('opacity', '1'); }

										$(_cover)[0].play();
									} else if($(_cover).attr('loaded') == 'true' && $(_cover)[0].paused){
										$(_cover)[0].play();
									} 
								}.bind(this));
							} else {
								if($(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video:not(.transparent)').attr('loaded') != null){
									$(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video:not(.transparent)')[0].pause(); 
								}
							}
						} 

						// animacion de navidad 
						if(typeof(snowContainer) != 'undefined' && snowContainer && inditex.isMobileDevice() && $(_entry.target).hasClass('snow-image')){
							if (_entry.isIntersecting) {
								if (snowInterval) { return; }
								createSnowflake();
								snowInterval = setInterval(function() { createSnowflake(); }, 150);
							}
							else {
								clearInterval(snowInterval);
								snowInterval = null;
							}
						}
						
					}.bind(this));			
				}.bind(this), {
					rootMargin: "0px",
					threshold: .5
				}
			);
			

			this.animObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
				function(_entries){ 
					_entries.forEach(function(_entry){
						if($(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video.transparent').length > 0){
							if(_entry.isIntersecting){
								$(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video.transparent').each(function(_index, _cover){
									if($(_cover).attr('loaded') == null){
										$(_cover).attr('loaded', true);										
										$(_cover).attr('src', $(_cover).attr('data-src'))
										//$(_cover).css('opacity', '1');
										$(_cover)[0].play();
									} else if($(_cover).attr('loaded') == 'true' && $(_cover)[0].paused){
										$(_cover)[0].play();
									} 
								}.bind(this));
							} else {
								if($(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video.transparent').attr('loaded') != null){
									$(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video.transparent')[0].pause(); 
								}
							}
						} 
						
					}.bind(this));			
				}.bind(this), {
					rootMargin: "0px",
					threshold: .01
				}
			);


			if(_dataJSON != null){		
				_dataJSON.forEach(function(value, index){
					try{
						switch(value.type){
							case 'ADVERTISMENT':
								// no migrado a APP 
								value.data.forEach(function(_data){
									if(index == 0 || index == 1){ _data.firstCover = true; }								
									if(this.isCoverVisible(_data)){
										this.coverAnuncio(_data);
									}
								}.bind(this));

							case 'BANNER':	
								value.data.forEach(function(_data){
									if(this.isCoverVisible(_data)){
										this.createBanner(_data);
									}
								}.bind(this));							
								break;
							case 'DOUBLE':	
								if(value.data.length > 0){		
									if(this.isCoverVisible(value.data)){
										this.coverDouble(value);
									}
								}
								break;
							case 'COUNTDOWN':
								// no migrada a APP 	
								value.data.forEach(function(_data){
									if(index == 0 || index == 1){ _data.firstCover = true; }
									if(this.isCoverVisible(_data)){
										this.coverCountdown(_data);
									}
								}.bind(this));
								break;
							case 'LEGAL':	
								value.data.forEach(function(_data){					
									if(this.isCoverVisible(_data)){
										this.coverLegal(_data);
									}
								}.bind(this));

									if(this.isCoverVisible(_data)){
										this.coverBigBanner(_data);

								if(value.data.length > 0){
									this.coverTrends(value);
								}
								break;								
						/*	case 'RECOMMENDED':	
								if(value.data.length > 0){
									this.coverHighlights(value);
								}
								break;		*/						
							case 'PROMOTIONV25':	
								value.data.forEach(function(_data){
									if(index == 0 || index == 1){ _data.firstCover = true; }
									if(this.isCoverVisible(_data)){
										this.coverPromotionsV25(_data);

			var SPAN_SECONDS = promoBlock.find('span#seconds');
			// Milliseconds for the calculations
			var MILLISECONDS_OF_A_SECOND = 1000;
			var MILLISECONDS_OF_A_MINUTE = MILLISECONDS_OF_A_SECOND * 60;
			var MILLISECONDS_OF_A_HOUR = MILLISECONDS_OF_A_MINUTE * 60;
			var MILLISECONDS_OF_A_DAY = MILLISECONDS_OF_A_HOUR * 24;	

			function updateCountdown() {
				// Calcs
				var NOW = new Date()
				var DURATION = DATE_TARGET - NOW;
				var REMAINING_DAYS = Math.floor(DURATION / MILLISECONDS_OF_A_DAY);
				var REMAINING_HOURS = Math.floor((DURATION % MILLISECONDS_OF_A_DAY) / MILLISECONDS_OF_A_HOUR);
				var REMAINING_MINUTES = Math.floor((DURATION % MILLISECONDS_OF_A_HOUR) / MILLISECONDS_OF_A_MINUTE);
				var REMAINING_SECONDS = Math.floor((DURATION % MILLISECONDS_OF_A_MINUTE) / MILLISECONDS_OF_A_SECOND);
		   
				// Render
				jQuery(SPAN_DAYS).html(REMAINING_DAYS);
				jQuery(SPAN_HOURS).html(REMAINING_HOURS);
				jQuery(SPAN_MINUTES).html(REMAINING_MINUTES);
				jQuery(SPAN_SECONDS).html(REMAINING_SECONDS);
			}

			updateCountdown();
			// Refresh every second
			setInterval(updateCountdown, MILLISECONDS_OF_A_SECOND);

			let percentage = data.percentage || "";
			let upto = data.upto || ""
			let percentChar = "";
			let modo; 
			if (percentage.length < 5) { percentage = percentage.split("%")[0]; percentChar = "%"; modo = "espanita" }
			else {
				function wrapDiscountParts(copy) {
				  // Reemplazamos el apóstrofe tipográfico por uno simple para evitar problemas
				  copy = copy.replace(/’/g, "'");
				  // Tokenizamos en números (incluidos negativos y números árabes), símbolos %, y texto
				  const tokens = copy.match(/[\d\u0660-\u0669\-]+|[%٪]|[^\s\d%٪\u0660-\u0669\-]+|\s+/g);
				  if (!tokens) return copy;

				  return tokens.map(token => {
				    if (/^[\d\u0660-\u0669\-]+$/.test(token)) {
				      return `<span class="numero">`+token+`</span>`;
				    } else if (/^[%٪]$/.test(token)) {
				      return `<span class="percent">`+token+`</span>`;
				    } else if (/^\s+$/.test(token)) {
				      return token; // conservar espacios
				    } else {
				      return `<span class="hasta">`+token+`</span>`;
				    }
				  }).join(' ');
				}
				// arabes y turco 
				percentage = wrapDiscountParts(upto + " " + percentage);
				percentage = percentage.replace('<span class="percent">', '<span class="percent percent-first">').replace('<span class="numero">', '<span class="numero numero-first">')
			}

			let cover = $(`

								</div>							
							</div>							
				        <div class="button-wrapper"></div>
				        <div class="title">`+data.title+`</div>
							</div>
		        <div class="banner-text-disclaimer">`+(data.disclaimer3 ? data.disclaimer3 : '')+`</div>
			    </div>
			  </li>
			`);


			if(modo != "espanita") { 
				$(cover).find('.discount').html(`
					<div class="discount-wrapped">
						`+percentage+`
					</div>`); 
			}

			let infoGA4 = this.setAnalyticsData(data);

		isCoverVisible: function(_cover){
			let now = new Date();
			if (typeof(this.LFHomeDate) != 'undefined') { now = this.LFHomeDate(); } // ?review 
			
			if(_cover.data != null && _cover.data.length == 0){ return false; }
			if(_cover.props != null){
				if(_cover.props.fechaini == null && _cover.props.fechafin == null){ return true; }
				
				if(_cover.props.fechaini){ _cover.props.fechaini = _cover.props.fechaini.replace('/', '-').replace('/', '-'); }
				if(_cover.props.fechafin){ _cover.props.fechafin = _cover.props.fechafin.replace('/', '-').replace('/', '-'); }
				
				//FECHAINI es mayor que la actual y FECHAFIN no existe o es menor que la actual
				if(new Date(_cover.props.fechaini) > now){ return false; }
				if(new Date(_cover.props.fechafin) < now && _cover.props.fechafin != null){ return false; }
			}		
			return true;

		groupCoversByType: function(_gender){
		let data = this.genderData[_gender];	
			// agrupar algunas covers según el type : recomendados y double por cómo se recibia antes la info 
			let coversSameType = [];
			let currentGroup = null;
			for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
				// setear las propiedades que vienen como array y objetos simulados
				let cover = this.setObjectData(data[i]);
				if (!currentGroup) { currentGroup = cover.type }

				if (this.coversAgrupadas.includes(cover.type)) {
					// mismo tipo que el grupo activo, añadimos
					if (currentGroup === cover.type) {
						coversSameType.push(cover);
					} else {
						// volcamos grupo anterior
						if (coversSameType.length > 0) { this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: coversSameType[0].type, data: coversSameType }); }
						coversSameType = [cover];
					}
					currentGroup = cover.type;
				} else {
					// cover que no se agrupa: volcamos grupo pendiente primero
					if (coversSameType.length > 0) {
						this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: coversSameType[0].type, data: coversSameType });
						coversSameType = [];
					}
					// luego añadimos cover no agrupable solo
					this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: cover.type, data: [cover] });
					currentGroup = null; // no hay grupo activo
				}
			}

			// al final, volcamos cualquier grupo pendiente
			if (coversSameType.length > 0) {
				this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: coversSameType[0].type, data: coversSameType });
			}
		},

		setPromotionsSize: function(_cover){
			let splits = $(_cover).find('.percent').html().split(' ').length;
			let sizeToGrow = .8;
			if(splits > 2){
				sizeToGrow = .75;
			} else if(splits > 1){
				sizeToGrow = .5
			}
			if($(window).width() > 1360){
				sizeToGrow = .35;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .5;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .5
				}
			} else if($(window).width() > 1024){			
				sizeToGrow = .25;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .45;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .45
				}
			} else if($(window).width() > 768){			
				sizeToGrow = .35;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .45;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .45
				}
			}
			
			let aux = $('<div style="display: inline-block; font-size:30px; opacity:0; pointer-events: none;">'+$(_cover).find('.percent').html()+'</div>');
			$('body').append(aux);
				
			while (aux.width() < $(window).width() * sizeToGrow && $(_cover).find('.percent').html() != '') {

				$(aux).css('font-size', pix+'px');
				$(_cover).find('.percent').css('font-size', pix+'px');
			}

			let throttledPromotionSize = function(){
				let splits = $(_cover).find('.percent').html().split(' ').length;
				let sizeToGrow = .8;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .75;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .5
				}
				if($(window).width() > 1360){
					sizeToGrow = .35;
					if(splits > 2){
						sizeToGrow = .5;
					} else if(splits > 1){
						sizeToGrow = .5
					}
				} else if($(window).width() > 1024){			
					sizeToGrow = .25;
					if(splits > 2){
						sizeToGrow = .45;
					} else if(splits > 1){
						sizeToGrow = .45
					}
				} else if($(window).width() > 768){			
					sizeToGrow = .35;
					if(splits > 2){
						sizeToGrow = .45;
					} else if(splits > 1){
						sizeToGrow = .45
					}
				}
				
				let aux = $('<div style="display: inline-block; font-size:30px; opacity:0; pointer-events: none;">'+$(_cover).find('.percent').html()+'</div>');
				$('body').append(aux);

				while (aux.width() < $(window).width() * sizeToGrow && $(_cover).find('.percent').html() != '') {

					$(aux).css('font-size', pix+'px');
					$(_cover).find('.percent').css('font-size', pix+'px');
				}

				aux.remove();
			}

			const throttledPromotion = _.throttle(throttledPromotionSize, 20);
			$(window).on('resize', throttledPromotion);
			
			aux.remove();
		},
		parseValue(value) {
			// objetos simulados desde CMS con separadores 
			if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length > 0 && value[0].indexOf(this.separador_OBJECT) !== -1) {
				let separador = this.separador_OBJECT;
				const obj = value.reduce(function(result, item) { 
					const parts = item.split(separador);
					result[parts[0]] = parts[1];
					return result;
				}, {});
				return obj
			}
			if (typeof value !== "string") return value;

			// obsoletos
			// objetos y arrays simulados desde el CMS con separadores 		
			// objeto: key€€value$$key€€value	(obsoleto)
			if (value.indexOf(this.separador_OBJECT) !== -1) {
				return Object.fromEntries(
				value.split(this.separador_ARRAY).map(p => p.split(this.separador_OBJECT))
				);
			}
			// array: a$$b$$c  (obsoleto)
			if (value.indexOf(this.separador_ARRAY) !== -1) {
				return value.split(this.separador_ARRAY);
			}
			return value;			

		},
		setObjectData: function(_data){

			let dataAux = _data;
			let newCoverProps = {};
			let objetosToAssign = []; 
			if (dataAux.props) {
				// procesar las propiedades que vienen como un objeto simulado, y los arrays 							
				for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(dataAux.props)) {
					let parsed = this.parseValue(value);
					if (parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
						objetosToAssign.push(parsed)
					} else {
						if(key == "categoryid" && parsed) {							
							if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) { parsed = [parsed] } // convertir categoryid en un array de 1 
							newCoverProps["url"] = [];
							parsed.forEach(function(_categoryId){ 
								if(isNaN(_categoryId)) {
									// /qrapps 
									newCoverProps["url"].push( _categoryId ); 
								}
								else {
									newCoverProps["url"].push( Inditex.generateUrl("ItxCategoryPage", { "categoryId": _categoryId, "storeId": Inditex.iStoreId, "langId": Inditex.iLangId, "catalogId": Inditex.iCatalogId }) ); 
								}
							})
						}						
						if(key == "buttontext" && parsed) { if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) { parsed = [parsed] } }						
						newCoverProps[key] = parsed;
					}
				}
				// las keys que vengan como objetos, añadirlas en la cover, pisando los campos que ya estuviesen en la cover
				objetosToAssign.forEach(function(_parsed) { Object.assign(newCoverProps, _parsed); })
				dataAux.props = newCoverProps;
			}
			dataAux.type = newCoverProps.type || "SIMPLE" ;
			dataAux.props.catTitle = (dataAux.props.title != null ? dataAux.props.title : '');	
			return dataAux;
		},
		setVideo: function(_data){

			let video =  data.video;
			let imageV =  data.image;
			let alt = _data.alt || "";
			
			$(html).find('.cover-media').empty();		

			if(inditex.isMobileDevice()){ 
				video = data.videoM; 
				imageV = data.imageM; 			
			}
			
			let posterHTML = '<img src="'+imageV+'" alt="'+alt+'" style="opacity: 1;" />';
			let videoHTML = '<video id="'+data.name+'-video" muted autoplay loop playsinline preload="none" data-src="'+video+'"></video>';

		setTransparentVideo: function(_data){
			let data = _data.propsJSON;
			let html = _data.elementHTML;
			let video;
			let imageV =  data.image;
			let alt = _data.alt || "";
			
			$(html).find('.cover-media').empty();

			let videoOrigin = data.videoAndroid ; 
			var isSafari = /^((?!chrome|chromium|crios|fxios|edg|opr|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
			if (isSafari) {
				videoOrigin = data.videoiOS; 
			}
			if(inditex.isMobileDevice() && videoOrigin.length > 1){ 
				video = videoOrigin[1]
				imageV = data.imageM; 			
			}
			else {
				video = videoOrigin[0]
			}
			
			let imageHTML = '<img src="'+imageV+'" alt="'+alt+'" style="opacity: 1;" />';
			let videoHTML = '<video id="'+data.name+'-video" muted autoplay loop playsinline preload="none" class="transparent" data-src="'+video+'"></video>';

			$(html).find('.cover-media').append(imageHTML);

		},		
		loadGender: function(_cat){

		setAnalyticsData( _coverData, _extraInfo) {
			try {
				let extraInfo = _extraInfo || {}; 
				// cover doble info del bloque en gaBloqueIndex 
				if (_coverData.gaBloqueIndex) { extraInfo.bloque = _coverData.gaBloqueIndex }
				
				let type = _coverData.type; 
				if (!_coverData.name) { _coverData.name = type }
				type = type && type.toLowerCase() || "simple";

				let normalizeType = function(type) {
					const exactReplacements = { "double": "doble", "recommended": "recomendados", "sale": "rebajas", "sections": "secciones", "menu": "simple", "countdown":"simple" };
					const partialReplacements = [ { match: "promotion", replace: "promociones" }, { match: "banner", replace: "banner" }, { match: "inlefties", replace: "simple" } ];
					for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(exactReplacements)) { type = type.replace(key, value); }
					for (const rule of partialReplacements) { if (type.includes(rule.match)) { return rule.replace; } }
					return type;
				}
				let creative_slot = normalizeType(type);
				
				let promotion_name = _coverData.name;   // usar el nombre del elemento de la cover 
				promotion_name = promotion_name.split("_i_")[0]; promotion_name = promotion_name.split("_e_")[0];
				let creative_name = promotion_name;
				
				let promotion_id = _coverData.image || "home"; // usar el nombre de la imagen 
				promotion_id = promotion_id.substr(promotion_id.lastIndexOf("/")+ 1).split(".")[0];
				
				let im_discount = "no";  // obtener el descuento del percentage 
				let checkPercentage;
				if (_coverData.percentage) { checkPercentage = _coverData.percentage }
				else if (_coverData.title && _coverData.title.indexOf("%") != -1) { checkPercentage = _coverData.title }
				if (checkPercentage) {
					let discount = [];				
					let textos = checkPercentage.split("%");
					if (textos.length > 0) {
						for (var i = 0; i < textos.length; i++) {
							textos[i] = textos[i].replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
							if (textos[i].length > 0) { discount.push(textos[i] + "%") }
						}
						discount = discount.join("-");
						im_discount = discount || "si";
					}
				}
				
				let location_id = "modulo_" + this.gaInfo.pos + ( extraInfo.bloque ? ("|bloque_" + extraInfo.bloque) : "");
				if (inditex.isMobileDevice()) {
					location_id = "modulo_" + this.gaInfo.posM + ( extraInfo.bloqueM ? ("|bloque_" + extraInfo.bloqueM) : "");
				}			

				let _infoGA4 = {
					creative_name: creative_name,
					creative_slot: creative_slot,
					promotion_name : promotion_name,
					promotion_id: promotion_id,
					im_discount: im_discount,
					location_id: location_id				
				}					
				this.gaInfo[_coverData.type + "_" + _coverData.name] = _infoGA4;
				// añadir im_link_type categoryId y menuType para el click 'select_promotion'
				return _infoGA4; 
			}
			catch(e){ console.error("setAnalyticsData",e)}
			
		}	

	});

	try{

	/* HARDCODEO SECTION NAME */
	inditex.iXProductJSON = { "sectionNameEnOrigin": '' };	

	inditex.iXHomeView = new inditex.iXViews.homeCovers();
	inditex.iXHomeView.getGenderTags(inditex.iXHomeView.initGender);

	inditex.onReady(function(){

			inditex.iXHomeView.render();

		}
		inditex.iXHomeView.onReady = true;

		$('#layout_content').append(inditex.iXHomeView.$el);
		$('html').addClass('home-menu');
	});
} catch(e){
	console.log(e);

/* animacion navidad nieve */
.snow-image {
    overflow: hidden;
}

.snow-image .cover-media {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.snowflake {
    position: absolute;
    top: -20px;
    color: #fff;
    line-height: 1;
    opacity: 0.85;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: snow-fall linear forwards;
}

@keyframes snow-fall {
    0% {
        top: -20px;
        transform: translateX(0) rotate(0deg);
    }

    25% {
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-1)) rotate(90deg);
    }

    50% {
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-2)) rotate(180deg);
    }

    75% {
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-1)) rotate(270deg);
    }

    100% {
        top: 110%;
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-2)) rotate(360deg);
    }
}
/* animacion navidad nieve */

/* video nieve transparente */
.lft-cover .cover-media video.transparent {
    bottom:0;
    right:0;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover; 
    opacity:0;
    transform: scale(0.98);
    transition: opacity 0.75s ease, transform 0.75s ease;    
}

.lft-cover .cover-media video.transparent:hover {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
}
/* video nieve transparente */
/* video-animation opacidad a 1 en hover */
.lft-cover.video-animation .cover-media video {
    opacity:0;
    transform: scale(1);
    transition: opacity 0.75s ease, transform 0.75s ease;    
}
.lft-cover.video-animation .cover-media video:hover {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
}

  @media screen and (max-width: 767px) {

					if (cat[subcats][index].id != 0o1) {
						cat[subcats][index].description = JSON.decode(cat[subcats][index].description);

			} catch (err) {

 //Get category JSON by categoryId. If the category tree is already loaded, it will return the category from the tree, otherwise it will make a REST request to get it.
  inditex.xRestGetCategory = function(categoryId) {
    if(inditex.iCategoryTreeJSON?.categories) {
      // Guardar el iCategoryId original
      const originalCategoryId = inditex.iCategoryId;
      
      // Establecer el nuevo
      inditex.iCategoryId = categoryId;
      
      // Obtener resultado

      // Restaurar el original
      inditex.iCategoryId = originalCategoryId;
      
      return Promise.resolve(result);
    }
    
    // Sino, hacer petición REST
    const action = {
      action: 'catalog:category',
      params: {
        storeId: inditex.iStoreId,
        catalogId: inditex.iCatalogId,
        categoryId: categoryId,
        languageId: inditex.iLangId
      }
    };

if(inditex.iXPublicVarsMap['product_single-product-query']){
 // Get products one by one.
  inditex.xRestGetProductsArrayUnitarios = function (productIds, categoryId) {
    if (!productIds.length) {
      return Promise.resolve([]);
    }

    const actions = productIds.map(id => {
      const params = {
        storeId: inditex.iStoreId,
        catalogId: inditex.iCatalogId,
        productIds: String(id),
        languageId: inditex.iLangId,
        milestoneCode: inditex.iParams.milestoneCode ? inditex.iParams.milestoneCode.join() : undefined,
        v1: inditex.iParams.v1 ? inditex.iParams.v1.join() : undefined
      };

      if (inditex.iParams.milestoneCode) {
        params.allowWithoutStock = true;
      } else if (location.hostname != 'www.lefties.com') {
        params.allowWithoutStock = true;
      } else {
        params.allowWithoutStock = false;
      }

      if (categoryId) {
        params.categoryId = categoryId;
      }

      return {
        action: 'GET_CATALOG_PRODUCTS_ESI',
        params
      };
    });

    // allSettled => nunca rechaza por fallo de una de las peticiones
    return Promise.allSettled(
      actions.map(action => inditex.xRestExecute([action]))
    ).then(results => {
      const allProducts = [];

      results.forEach((result, index) => {
        if (result.status === 'fulfilled') {
          const data = result.value;
          if (data && data[0] && Array.isArray(data[0].products)) {
            allProducts.push(...data[0].products);
          }
        } else {
          // aquí puedes loguear o trackear el error asociado al productId filtrados[index]
          console.error('Error obteniendo producto', productIds[index], result.reason);
        }
      });

      return allProducts;
    });
  };

  inditex.xRestGetProductsArray = inditex.xRestGetProductsArrayUnitarios;
}

		createCovers: function(_dataJSON){
			universalAnalytics.sendInitialPageviewByiPageName();

			this.checkColorThemeScroll  = _.throttle(this.checkColorTheme.bind(this), 20);
			$(window).on('scroll', this.checkColorThemeScroll);

			this.coversObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
				function(_entries){ 
					_entries.forEach(function(_entry){
						if($(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video:not(.transparent)').length > 0){
							if(_entry.isIntersecting){
								$(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video:not(.transparent)').each(function(_index, _cover){
									if($(_cover).attr('loaded') == null){
										$(_cover).attr('loaded', true);										

										let hls = null;
										if(Hls.isSupported() && $(_cover).attr('data-src').indexOf(".mp4?") == -1){
											hls = new Hls();
											hls.loadSource($(_cover).attr('data-src'));
											hls.attachMedia(_cover);
										} else {
											$(_cover).attr('src', $(_cover).attr('data-src'))
										}

										// si es video animacion, el video se hace visible con el hover 
										let li = _entry.target.closest("li.video-animation");
										if(!li) { $(_cover).css('opacity', '1'); }

										$(_cover)[0].play();
									} else if($(_cover).attr('loaded') == 'true' && $(_cover)[0].paused){
										$(_cover)[0].play();
									} 
								}.bind(this));
							} else {
								if($(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video:not(.transparent)').attr('loaded') != null){
									$(_entry.target).find('.cover-media video:not(.transparent)')[0].pause(); 
								}

						// animacion de navidad 
						if(typeof(snowContainer) != 'undefined' && snowContainer && inditex.isMobileDevice() && $(_entry.target).hasClass('snow-image')){
							if (_entry.isIntersecting) {
								if (snowInterval) { return; }
								createSnowflake();
								snowInterval = setInterval(function() { createSnowflake(); }, 150);
							}
							else {
								clearInterval(snowInterval);
								snowInterval = null;
							}
						}
						
					}.bind(this));			
				}.bind(this), {
					rootMargin: "0px",
					threshold: .5
				}
			);
			

			this.animObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
				function(_entries){

							if(_entry.isIntersecting){

		createBanner: function(_cover){
			this.gaInfo.pos++; this.gaInfo.posM++;			
			let data = _cover.props;
			let aux = $('<div style="display: inline-block;">'+data.title+'</div>');
			$('body').append(aux);
			
			function repeatStr(n, s) {
				if (n <= 0) {
					return "";
				}
				return s + repeatStr(n - 1, s);
			}
			
			let numRepeat = Math.ceil($(window).width() / aux.width()) * 2;
			//let dataFinal = repeatStr(numRepeat, data.title + ' | ');
			let dataFinal = repeatStr(numRepeat, data.title + ' *      * ');
			
			aux.remove();

			if(data.static){
				dataFinal = '<div style="display: inline-block;">'+data.title+'</div>';
			}

			let cover;
			if(data.url){
				cover = $('<a class="cover-banner lft-cover" data-dinamic="'+ (data.static ? 'false' : 'true') +'" style="color: '+data.color+'; background: '+data.background+';" href="'+data.url[0]+'" block="'+_cover.type+'" name="'+_cover.name+'"><div class="cover-banner-marquee">'+dataFinal+'</div></a>');

		coverPromotionsBigBanner: function(_cover){

			data.name = _cover.name.replace(' ', '_');

			let img, imgMobile = null;
			let width = Math.floor(($(window).width()/2) * this.deviceRatio);

			if(data.image != null && data.imageM != null){
				img = data.image.concat('&w=' + width);
				imgMobile = data.imageM.concat('&w=' + width);				
			}

			let percentage = data.percentage || "";
			let upto = data.upto || ""
			let percentChar = "";
			let modo; 
			if (percentage.length < 5) { percentage = percentage.split("%")[0]; percentChar = "%"; modo = "espanita" }
			else {
				function wrapDiscountParts(copy) {
				  // Reemplazamos el apóstrofe tipográfico por uno simple para evitar problemas
				  copy = copy.replace(/’/g, "'");
				  // Tokenizamos en números (incluidos negativos y números árabes), símbolos %, y texto
				  const tokens = copy.match(/[\d\u0660-\u0669\-]+|[%٪]|[^\s\d%٪\u0660-\u0669\-]+|\s+/g);
				  if (!tokens) return copy;

				  return tokens.map(token => {
				    if (/^[\d\u0660-\u0669\-]+$/.test(token)) {
				      return `<span class="numero">`+token+`</span>`;
				    } else if (/^[%٪]$/.test(token)) {
				      return `<span class="percent">`+token+`</span>`;
				    } else if (/^\s+$/.test(token)) {
				      return token; // conservar espacios
				    } else {
				      return `<span class="hasta">`+token+`</span>`;
				    }
				  }).join(' ');
				}
				// arabes y turco 
				percentage = wrapDiscountParts(upto + " " + percentage);
				percentage = percentage.replace('<span class="percent">', '<span class="percent percent-first">').replace('<span class="numero">', '<span class="numero numero-first">')
			}

			let cover = $(`
			  <li class="lft-cover cover-sales-big-banner `+(data.clases ? data.clases : '')+`"

								<div class="discount-wrapped">
									<span class="hasta">`+upto+`</span>
									<span class="numero">`+percentage+`</span>
									<span class="percent">`+percentChar+`</span>
								</div>							
							</div>							
				        <div class="button-wrapper"></div>
				        <div class="title">`+data.title+`</div>
							</div>
		        <div class="banner-text-disclaimer">`+(data.disclaimer3 ? data.disclaimer3 : '')+`</div>
			    </div>
			  </li>
			`);


			if(modo != "espanita") { 
				$(cover).find('.discount').html(`
					<div class="discount-wrapped">
						`+percentage+`
					</div>`); 
			}

			let infoGA4 = this.setAnalyticsData(data);
			this.setButtons(_cover, $(cover).find('.button-wrapper'),infoGA4);
			this.setColor(cover, data);
			$($(cover).find('img')).on('load', function() {

			$(cover).on('click', function(e) {

				universalAnalytics.clickHomeCover_v2(infoGA4);

			if(data.video){ this.setVideo({ propsJSON: data, elementHTML: cover, firstCover: _cover.firstCover }); }

			if(_cover.data != null && _cover.data.length == 0){ return false; }
			if(_cover.props != null){

			this.groupCoversByType(_gender); // agrupa las covers por TYPE en this.homesJSON 

			inditex.iHomeJSON = { [_gender] : this.homesJSON[_gender] } ;

		groupCoversByType: function(_gender){
		let data = this.genderData[_gender];	
			// agrupar algunas covers según el type : recomendados y double por cómo se recibia antes la info 
			let coversSameType = [];
			let currentGroup = null;
			for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
				// setear las propiedades que vienen como array y objetos simulados
				let cover = this.setObjectData(data[i]);
				if (!currentGroup) { currentGroup = cover.type }

				if (this.coversAgrupadas.includes(cover.type)) {
					// mismo tipo que el grupo activo, añadimos
					if (currentGroup === cover.type) {
						coversSameType.push(cover);
					} else {
						// volcamos grupo anterior
						if (coversSameType.length > 0) { this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: coversSameType[0].type, data: coversSameType }); }
						coversSameType = [cover];
					}
					currentGroup = cover.type;
				} else {
					// cover que no se agrupa: volcamos grupo pendiente primero
					if (coversSameType.length > 0) {
						this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: coversSameType[0].type, data: coversSameType });
						coversSameType = [];
					}
					// luego añadimos cover no agrupable solo
					this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: cover.type, data: [cover] });
					currentGroup = null; // no hay grupo activo
				}
			}

			// al final, volcamos cualquier grupo pendiente
			if (coversSameType.length > 0) {
				this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: coversSameType[0].type, data: coversSameType });
			}
		},

		setPromotionsSize: function(_cover){
			let splits = $(_cover).find('.percent').html().split(' ').length;

			if(splits > 2){
				sizeToGrow = .75;
			} else if(splits > 1){
				sizeToGrow = .5
			}
			if($(window).width() > 1360){
				sizeToGrow = .35;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .5;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .5
				}
			} else if($(window).width() > 1024){			
				sizeToGrow = .25;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .45;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .45
				}
			} else if($(window).width() > 768){			
				sizeToGrow = .35;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .45;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .45
				}
			}
			
			let aux = $('<div style="display: inline-block; font-size:30px; opacity:0; pointer-events: none;">'+$(_cover).find('.percent').html()+'</div>');
			$('body').append(aux);
				
			while (aux.width() < $(window).width() * sizeToGrow && $(_cover).find('.percent').html() != '') {
				let pix = parseInt($(aux).css('font-size').replace('px','')) + 2;
				$(aux).css('font-size', pix+'px');
				$(_cover).find('.percent').css('font-size', pix+'px');
			}

			let throttledPromotionSize = function(){
				let splits = $(_cover).find('.percent').html().split(' ').length;
				let sizeToGrow = .8;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .75;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .5
				}
				if($(window).width() > 1360){
					sizeToGrow = .35;
					if(splits > 2){
						sizeToGrow = .5;
					} else if(splits > 1){
						sizeToGrow = .5
					}
				} else if($(window).width() > 1024){			
					sizeToGrow = .25;
					if(splits > 2){
						sizeToGrow = .45;
					} else if(splits > 1){
						sizeToGrow = .45
					}
				} else if($(window).width() > 768){			
					sizeToGrow = .35;
					if(splits > 2){
						sizeToGrow = .45;
					} else if(splits > 1){
						sizeToGrow = .45
					}
				}
				
				let aux = $('<div style="display: inline-block; font-size:30px; opacity:0; pointer-events: none;">'+$(_cover).find('.percent').html()+'</div>');
				$('body').append(aux);

				while (aux.width() < $(window).width() * sizeToGrow && $(_cover).find('.percent').html() != '') {
					let pix = parseInt($(aux).css('font-size').replace('px','')) + 2;
					$(aux).css('font-size', pix+'px');
					$(_cover).find('.percent').css('font-size', pix+'px');
				}

				aux.remove();
			}

			const throttledPromotion = _.throttle(throttledPromotionSize, 20);
			$(window).on('resize', throttledPromotion);
			
			aux.remove();
		},
		parseValue(value) {
			// objetos simulados desde CMS con separadores 
			if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length > 0 && value[0].indexOf(this.separador_OBJECT) !== -1) {
				let separador = this.separador_OBJECT;
				const obj = value.reduce(function(result, item) { 
					const parts = item.split(separador);
					result[parts[0]] = parts[1];
					return result;
				}, {});
				return obj
			}
			if (typeof value !== "string") return value;

			// obsoletos
			// objetos y arrays simulados desde el CMS con separadores 		
			// objeto: key€€value$$key€€value	(obsoleto)
			if (value.indexOf(this.separador_OBJECT) !== -1) {
				return Object.fromEntries(
				value.split(this.separador_ARRAY).map(p => p.split(this.separador_OBJECT))
				);
			}
			// array: a$$b$$c  (obsoleto)
			if (value.indexOf(this.separador_ARRAY) !== -1) {
				return value.split(this.separador_ARRAY);
			}
			return value;			

		},
		setObjectData: function(_data){

			let dataAux = _data;
			let newCoverProps = {};
			let objetosToAssign = []; 
			if (dataAux.props) {
				// procesar las propiedades que vienen como un objeto simulado, y los arrays 							
				for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(dataAux.props)) {
					let parsed = this.parseValue(value);
					if (parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
						objetosToAssign.push(parsed)
					} else {
						if(key == "categoryid" && parsed) {							
							if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) { parsed = [parsed] } // convertir categoryid en un array de 1 
							newCoverProps["url"] = [];
							parsed.forEach(function(_categoryId){ 
								if(isNaN(_categoryId)) {
									// /qrapps 
									newCoverProps["url"].push( _categoryId ); 
								}
								else {
									newCoverProps["url"].push( Inditex.generateUrl("ItxCategoryPage", { "categoryId": _categoryId, "storeId": Inditex.iStoreId, "langId": Inditex.iLangId, "catalogId": Inditex.iCatalogId }) ); 
								}
							})
						}						
						if(key == "buttontext" && parsed) { if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) { parsed = [parsed] } }						
						newCoverProps[key] = parsed;
					}
				}
				// las keys que vengan como objetos, añadirlas en la cover, pisando los campos que ya estuviesen en la cover
				objetosToAssign.forEach(function(_parsed) { Object.assign(newCoverProps, _parsed); })
				dataAux.props = newCoverProps;
			}
			dataAux.type = newCoverProps.type || "SIMPLE" ;
			dataAux.props.catTitle = (dataAux.props.title != null ? dataAux.props.title : '');	
			return dataAux;
		},
		setVideo: function(_data){
			let data = _data.propsJSON;
			let html = _data.elementHTML;
			let video =  data.video;
			let imageV =  data.image;
			let alt = _data.alt || "";
			
			$(html).find('.cover-media').empty();		

			if(inditex.isMobileDevice()){ 
				video = data.videoM; 
				imageV = data.imageM; 			
			}
			
			let posterHTML = '<img src="'+imageV+'" alt="'+alt+'" style="opacity: 1;" />';
			let videoHTML = '<video id="'+data.name+'-video" muted autoplay loop playsinline preload="none" data-src="'+video+'"></video>';

			$(html).find('.cover-media').append(posterHTML);
			$(html).find('.cover-media').append(videoHTML);
		},
		setTransparentVideo: function(_data){
			let data = _data.propsJSON;
			let html = _data.elementHTML;
			let video;
			let imageV =  data.image;
			let alt = _data.alt || "";
			
			$(html).find('.cover-media').empty();		

			// video transparente , diferente version para safari (videoiOS) que resto (videoAndroid)			
			let videoOrigin = data.videoAndroid ; 
			var isSafari = /^((?!chrome|chromium|crios|fxios|edg|opr|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
			if (isSafari) {
				videoOrigin = data.videoiOS; 
			}
			if(inditex.isMobileDevice() && videoOrigin.length > 1){ 
				video = videoOrigin[1]
				imageV = data.imageM; 			
			}
			else {
				video = videoOrigin[0]
			}
			
			let imageHTML = '<img src="'+imageV+'" alt="'+alt+'" style="opacity: 1;" />';
			let videoHTML = '<video id="'+data.name+'-video" muted autoplay loop playsinline preload="none" class="transparent" data-src="'+video+'"></video>';

			$(html).find('.cover-media').append(imageHTML);
			$(html).find('.cover-media').append(videoHTML);

			if (this.animObserver){ this.animObserver.observe(html[0]); }
		},		
		loadGender: function(_cat){
			this.$el.empty();
			this.initGender = _cat;

			this.initGender = this.initGender.concat("-2026");
			/*if(inditex.iXPublicVarsMap.cmsHomePageSuffix && inditex.iXPublicVarsMap.cmsHomePageSuffix != ''){
				this.initGender = this.initGender.concat(inditex.iXPublicVarsMap.cmsHomePageSuffix);
			}*/

			window.location.hash = '#' + this.initGender.split('-')[1];
			if(this.homesJSON[this.initGender] == null){
				this.getGenderTags(this.initGender);
			} else {
				inditex.iHomeJSON = this.genderData[this.initGender];
				this.createCovers(this.homesJSON[this.initGender]);
			}

			try{				
				inditex.LFGender.setGenderCookie();
				inditex.iXProductJSON.sectionNameEnOrigin = hardSectionName[this.initGender.split('-')[1]];
			} catch(e) {
				console.log(e);
			}
		},
		setAnalyticsData( _coverData, _extraInfo) {
			try {
				let extraInfo = _extraInfo || {}; 
				// cover doble info del bloque en gaBloqueIndex 
				if (_coverData.gaBloqueIndex) { extraInfo.bloque = _coverData.gaBloqueIndex }
				
				let type = _coverData.type; 
				if (!_coverData.name) { _coverData.name = type }
				type = type && type.toLowerCase() || "simple";

				let normalizeType = function(type) {
					const exactReplacements = { "double": "doble", "recommended": "recomendados", "sale": "rebajas", "sections": "secciones", "menu": "simple", "countdown":"simple" };
					const partialReplacements = [ { match: "promotion", replace: "promociones" }, { match: "banner", replace: "banner" }, { match: "inlefties", replace: "simple" } ];
					for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(exactReplacements)) { type = type.replace(key, value); }
					for (const rule of partialReplacements) { if (type.includes(rule.match)) { return rule.replace; } }
					return type;
				}
				let creative_slot = normalizeType(type);
				
				let promotion_name = _coverData.name;   // usar el nombre del elemento de la cover 
				promotion_name = promotion_name.split("_i_")[0]; promotion_name = promotion_name.split("_e_")[0];
				let creative_name = promotion_name;
				
				let promotion_id = _coverData.image || "home"; // usar el nombre de la imagen 
				promotion_id = promotion_id.substr(promotion_id.lastIndexOf("/")+ 1).split(".")[0];
				
				let im_discount = "no";  // obtener el descuento del percentage 
				let checkPercentage;
				if (_coverData.percentage) { checkPercentage = _coverData.percentage }
				else if (_coverData.title && _coverData.title.indexOf("%") != -1) { checkPercentage = _coverData.title }
				if (checkPercentage) {
					let discount = [];				
					let textos = checkPercentage.split("%");
					if (textos.length > 0) {
						for (var i = 0; i < textos.length; i++) {
							textos[i] = textos[i].replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
							if (textos[i].length > 0) { discount.push(textos[i] + "%") }
						}
						discount = discount.join("-");
						im_discount = discount || "si";
					}
				}
				
				let location_id = "modulo_" + this.gaInfo.pos + ( extraInfo.bloque ? ("|bloque_" + extraInfo.bloque) : "");
				if (inditex.isMobileDevice()) {
					location_id = "modulo_" + this.gaInfo.posM + ( extraInfo.bloqueM ? ("|bloque_" + extraInfo.bloqueM) : "");
				}			

				let _infoGA4 = {
					creative_name: creative_name,
					creative_slot: creative_slot,
					promotion_name : promotion_name,
					promotion_id: promotion_id,
					im_discount: im_discount,
					location_id: location_id				
				}					
				this.gaInfo[_coverData.type + "_" + _coverData.name] = _infoGA4;
				// añadir im_link_type categoryId y menuType para el click 'select_promotion'
				return _infoGA4; 
			}
			catch(e){ console.error("setAnalyticsData",e)}
			
		}	

	});

	try{

	/* HARDCODEO SECTION NAME */
	inditex.iXProductJSON = { "sectionNameEnOrigin": '' };	

	inditex.iXHomeView = new inditex.iXViews.homeCovers();
	inditex.iXHomeView.getGenderTags(inditex.iXHomeView.initGender);

	inditex.onReady(function(){
		if(inditex.iXHomeView.genderData[inditex.iXHomeView.initGender] != null && inditex.iXHomeView.firstTime){
			inditex.iXHomeView.render();
			inditex.iXHomeView.firstTime = false;
		}
		inditex.iXHomeView.onReady = true;

		$('#layout_content').append(inditex.iXHomeView.$el);
		$('html').addClass('home-menu');
	});
} catch(e){
	console.log(e);
}

/* animacion navidad nieve */
.snow-image {
    overflow: hidden;
}

.snow-image .cover-media {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.snowflake {
    position: absolute;
    top: -20px;
    color: #fff;
    line-height: 1;
    opacity: 0.85;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: snow-fall linear forwards;
}

@keyframes snow-fall {
    0% {
        top: -20px;
        transform: translateX(0) rotate(0deg);
    }

    25% {
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-1)) rotate(90deg);
    }

    50% {
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-2)) rotate(180deg);
    }

    75% {
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-1)) rotate(270deg);
    }

    100% {
        top: 110%;
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-2)) rotate(360deg);
    }
}
/* animacion navidad nieve */

/* video nieve transparente */
.lft-cover .cover-media video.transparent {
    bottom:0;
    right:0;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover; 
    opacity:0;
    transform: scale(0.98);
    transition: opacity 0.75s ease, transform 0.75s ease;    
}

 //Get category JSON by categoryId. If the category tree is already loaded, it will return the category from the tree, otherwise it will make a REST request to get it.
  inditex.xRestGetCategory = function(categoryId) {
    if(inditex.iCategoryTreeJSON?.categories) {
      // Guardar el iCategoryId original
      const originalCategoryId = inditex.iCategoryId;
      
      // Establecer el nuevo
      inditex.iCategoryId = categoryId;
      
      // Obtener resultado
      const result = inditex.getCategoryJSON(inditex.iCategoryTreeJSON.categories);
      
      // Restaurar el original
      inditex.iCategoryId = originalCategoryId;
      
      return Promise.resolve(result);
    }
    
    // Sino, hacer petición REST
    const action = {
      action: 'catalog:category',
      params: {
        storeId: inditex.iStoreId,
        catalogId: inditex.iCatalogId,
        categoryId: categoryId,
        languageId: inditex.iLangId
      }
    };
    
    return inditex.xRestExecute([action]).then(data => data[0]);
  };

if(inditex.iXPublicVarsMap['product_single-product-query']){
 // Get products one by one.
  inditex.xRestGetProductsArrayUnitarios = function (productIds, categoryId) {
    if (!productIds.length) {
      return Promise.resolve([]);
    }

    const actions = productIds.map(id => {
      const params = {
        storeId: inditex.iStoreId,
        catalogId: inditex.iCatalogId,
        productIds: String(id),
        languageId: inditex.iLangId,
        milestoneCode: inditex.iParams.milestoneCode ? inditex.iParams.milestoneCode.join() : undefined,
        v1: inditex.iParams.v1 ? inditex.iParams.v1.join() : undefined
      };

      if (inditex.iParams.milestoneCode) {
        params.allowWithoutStock = true;
      } else if (location.hostname != 'www.lefties.com') {
        params.allowWithoutStock = true;
      } else {
        params.allowWithoutStock = false;
      }

      if (categoryId) {
        params.categoryId = categoryId;
      }

      return {
        action: 'GET_CATALOG_PRODUCTS_ESI',
        params
      };
    });

    // allSettled => nunca rechaza por fallo de una de las peticiones
    return Promise.allSettled(
      actions.map(action => inditex.xRestExecute([action]))
    ).then(results => {
      const allProducts = [];

      results.forEach((result, index) => {
        if (result.status === 'fulfilled') {
          const data = result.value;
          if (data && data[0] && Array.isArray(data[0].products)) {
            allProducts.push(...data[0].products);
          }
        } else {
          // aquí puedes loguear o trackear el error asociado al productId filtrados[index]
          console.error('Error obteniendo producto', productIds[index], result.reason);
        }
      });

      return allProducts;
    });
  };

  inditex.xRestGetProductsArray = inditex.xRestGetProductsArrayUnitarios;
}

		createBanner: function(_cover){
			this.gaInfo.pos++; this.gaInfo.posM++;			
			let data = _cover.props;
			let aux = $('<div style="display: inline-block;">'+data.title+'</div>');
			$('body').append(aux);
			
			function repeatStr(n, s) {
				if (n <= 0) {
					return "";
				}
				return s + repeatStr(n - 1, s);
			}
			
			let numRepeat = Math.ceil($(window).width() / aux.width()) * 2;
			//let dataFinal = repeatStr(numRepeat, data.title + ' | ');
			let dataFinal = repeatStr(numRepeat, data.title + ' *      * ');
			
			aux.remove();

			if(data.static){
				dataFinal = '<div style="display: inline-block;">'+data.title+'</div>';
			}

			let cover;
			if(data.url){
				cover = $('<a class="cover-banner lft-cover" data-dinamic="'+ (data.static ? 'false' : 'true') +'" style="color: '+data.color+'; background: '+data.background+';" href="'+data.url[0]+'" block="'+_cover.type+'" name="'+_cover.name+'"><div class="cover-banner-marquee">'+dataFinal+'</div></a>');
			} else {
				cover = $('<div class="cover-banner lft-cover" data-dinamic="'+ (data.static ? 'false' : 'true') +'" style="color: '+data.color+'; background: '+data.background+';" block="'+_cover.type+'" name="'+_cover.name+'"><div class="cover-banner-marquee">'+dataFinal+'</div></div>');
			}
			data.name = _cover.name; 
			let infoGA4 = this.setAnalyticsData(data);			
			cover.on('click', function(e) {
				if (data["categoryid"][0]) {
					infoGA4["categoryId"] = data["categoryid"][0];
					infoGA4["im_link_type"] = "banner";
					universalAnalytics.clickHomeCover_v2(infoGA4);
				}
			});
			
			// hacer visible sin scroll 
			if (data.visiblesinscroll && data.visiblesinscroll.trim().length > 0) {
				this.updateaHeightPorfa = true; 
				let root = document.querySelector(':root');
				const interval = setInterval(() => {
					const height = cover.innerHeight(); // Asumiendo que cover es jQuery
					if (height > 0) {

					}

			// Milliseconds for the calculations
			var MILLISECONDS_OF_A_SECOND = 1000;
			var MILLISECONDS_OF_A_MINUTE = MILLISECONDS_OF_A_SECOND * 60;
			var MILLISECONDS_OF_A_HOUR = MILLISECONDS_OF_A_MINUTE * 60;
			var MILLISECONDS_OF_A_DAY = MILLISECONDS_OF_A_HOUR * 24;	

			function updateCountdown() {
				// Calcs
				var NOW = new Date()
				var DURATION = DATE_TARGET - NOW;
				var REMAINING_DAYS = Math.floor(DURATION / MILLISECONDS_OF_A_DAY);
				var REMAINING_HOURS = Math.floor((DURATION % MILLISECONDS_OF_A_DAY) / MILLISECONDS_OF_A_HOUR);
				var REMAINING_MINUTES = Math.floor((DURATION % MILLISECONDS_OF_A_HOUR) / MILLISECONDS_OF_A_MINUTE);
				var REMAINING_SECONDS = Math.floor((DURATION % MILLISECONDS_OF_A_MINUTE) / MILLISECONDS_OF_A_SECOND);
		   
				// Render
				jQuery(SPAN_DAYS).html(REMAINING_DAYS);
				jQuery(SPAN_HOURS).html(REMAINING_HOURS);
				jQuery(SPAN_MINUTES).html(REMAINING_MINUTES);
				jQuery(SPAN_SECONDS).html(REMAINING_SECONDS);
			}

			updateCountdown();
			// Refresh every second
			setInterval(updateCountdown, MILLISECONDS_OF_A_SECOND);

			this.gaInfo.pos++; this.gaInfo.posM++;

			data.name = _cover.name.replace(' ', '_');

			if(data.image != null && data.imageM != null){
				img = data.image.concat('&w=' + width);
				imgMobile = data.imageM.concat('&w=' + width);				
			}

			let percentage = data.percentage || "";
			let upto = data.upto || ""
			let percentChar = "";
			let modo; 
			if (percentage.length < 5) { percentage = percentage.split("%")[0]; percentChar = "%"; modo = "espanita" }
			else {
				function wrapDiscountParts(copy) {
				  // Reemplazamos el apóstrofe tipográfico por uno simple para evitar problemas
				  copy = copy.replace(/’/g, "'");
				  // Tokenizamos en números (incluidos negativos y números árabes), símbolos %, y texto
				  const tokens = copy.match(/[\d\u0660-\u0669\-]+|[%٪]|[^\s\d%٪\u0660-\u0669\-]+|\s+/g);
				  if (!tokens) return copy;

				  return tokens.map(token => {
				    if (/^[\d\u0660-\u0669\-]+$/.test(token)) {
				      return `<span class="numero">`+token+`</span>`;
				    } else if (/^[%٪]$/.test(token)) {
				      return `<span class="percent">`+token+`</span>`;
				    } else if (/^\s+$/.test(token)) {
				      return token; // conservar espacios
				    } else {
				      return `<span class="hasta">`+token+`</span>`;
				    }
				  }).join(' ');
				}
				// arabes y turco 
				percentage = wrapDiscountParts(upto + " " + percentage);
				percentage = percentage.replace('<span class="percent">', '<span class="percent percent-first">').replace('<span class="numero">', '<span class="numero numero-first">')
			}

			let cover = $(`
			  <li class="lft-cover cover-sales-big-banner `+(data.clases ? data.clases : '')+`"

									<span class="hasta">`+upto+`</span>
									<span class="numero">`+percentage+`</span>
									<span class="percent">`+percentChar+`</span>
								</div>							
							</div>							
				        <div class="button-wrapper"></div>
				        <div class="title">`+data.title+`</div>
							</div>
		        <div class="banner-text-disclaimer">`+(data.disclaimer3 ? data.disclaimer3 : '')+`</div>
			    </div>
			  </li>
			`);


			if(modo != "espanita") { 
				$(cover).find('.discount').html(`
					<div class="discount-wrapped">
						`+percentage+`
					</div>`); 
			}

			let infoGA4 = this.setAnalyticsData(data);
			this.setButtons(_cover, $(cover).find('.button-wrapper'),infoGA4);
			this.setColor(cover, data);
			$($(cover).find('img')).on('load', function() {
			  	$(this).addClass('loaded');

			$(cover).on('click', function(e) {
				if (data.clases.indexOf("clickable") != -1) {

				universalAnalytics.clickHomeCover_v2(infoGA4);
			});
			
			if(data.video){ this.setVideo({ propsJSON: data, elementHTML: cover, firstCover: _cover.firstCover }); }			

			this.$el.append(cover);

		isCoverVisible: function(_cover){
			let now = new Date();
			if (typeof(this.LFHomeDate) != 'undefined') { now = this.LFHomeDate(); } // ?review 
			
			if(_cover.data != null && _cover.data.length == 0){ return false; }
			if(_cover.props != null){
				if(_cover.props.fechaini == null && _cover.props.fechafin == null){ return true; }
				
				if(_cover.props.fechaini){ _cover.props.fechaini = _cover.props.fechaini.replace('/', '-').replace('/', '-'); }
				if(_cover.props.fechafin){ _cover.props.fechafin = _cover.props.fechafin.replace('/', '-').replace('/', '-'); }
				
				//FECHAINI es mayor que la actual y FECHAFIN no existe o es menor que la actual
				if(new Date(_cover.props.fechaini) > now){ return false; }
				if(new Date(_cover.props.fechafin) < now && _cover.props.fechafin != null){ return false; }
			}		
			return true;
		},

			inditex.iHomeJSON_GA = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.homesJSON[_gender]));

			this.createCovers(this.homesJSON[_gender]);
			this.checkInScreen();

		groupCoversByType: function(_gender){
		let data = this.genderData[_gender];	
			// agrupar algunas covers según el type : recomendados y double por cómo se recibia antes la info 
			let coversSameType = [];
			let currentGroup = null;
			for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
				// setear las propiedades que vienen como array y objetos simulados
				let cover = this.setObjectData(data[i]);
				if (!currentGroup) { currentGroup = cover.type }

				if (this.coversAgrupadas.includes(cover.type)) {
					// mismo tipo que el grupo activo, añadimos
					if (currentGroup === cover.type) {
						coversSameType.push(cover);
					} else {
						// volcamos grupo anterior
						if (coversSameType.length > 0) { this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: coversSameType[0].type, data: coversSameType }); }
						coversSameType = [cover];
					}
					currentGroup = cover.type;
				} else {
					// cover que no se agrupa: volcamos grupo pendiente primero
					if (coversSameType.length > 0) {
						this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: coversSameType[0].type, data: coversSameType });
						coversSameType = [];
					}
					// luego añadimos cover no agrupable solo
					this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: cover.type, data: [cover] });
					currentGroup = null; // no hay grupo activo
				}
			}

			// al final, volcamos cualquier grupo pendiente
			if (coversSameType.length > 0) {
				this.homesJSON[_gender].push({ type: coversSameType[0].type, data: coversSameType });
			}
		},
		setButtons: function(_coverData, _container, _infoGA4){

						if(data.menuType){

								if (infoGA4) { universalAnalytics.clickHomeCover_v2(infoGA4); }								
							}.bind(this));
						} else {
							cat.on('click', function(e) {
								e.stopPropagation();
								if (infoGA4) { universalAnalytics.clickHomeCover_v2(infoGA4);	}
							}.bind(this));

				switch (buttons.length) {
					case 3:
						$(_container).addClass('three-buttons');
				    break;					
					case 4:
						$(_container).addClass('four-buttons');
				    break;					
				  case 5:

						$(_container).addClass('five-buttons');

						ref6.before(nuevoE6);

						$(_container).addClass('six-buttons');
				    break;
				  default:
				    if(buttons.length > 4){
						$(_container).addClass('mult-buttons');
					}	
				}				
			}
		},

		setAppButtonMobile: function(_data, _container,_infoGA4){
			let cat = $(`<li class="cover-button download-app"><div class="name">`+_data["buttontext"][0]+`</div></li>`);
			$(_container).append(cat);

		setPromotionsSize: function(_cover){
			let splits = $(_cover).find('.percent').html().split(' ').length;
			let sizeToGrow = .8;
			if(splits > 2){
				sizeToGrow = .75;
			} else if(splits > 1){
				sizeToGrow = .5
			}
			if($(window).width() > 1360){
				sizeToGrow = .35;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .5;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .5
				}
			} else if($(window).width() > 1024){			
				sizeToGrow = .25;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .45;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .45
				}
			} else if($(window).width() > 768){			
				sizeToGrow = .35;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .45;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .45
				}
			}
			
			let aux = $('<div style="display: inline-block; font-size:30px; opacity:0; pointer-events: none;">'+$(_cover).find('.percent').html()+'</div>');
			$('body').append(aux);
				
			while (aux.width() < $(window).width() * sizeToGrow && $(_cover).find('.percent').html() != '') {
				let pix = parseInt($(aux).css('font-size').replace('px','')) + 2;
				$(aux).css('font-size', pix+'px');
				$(_cover).find('.percent').css('font-size', pix+'px');
			}

			let throttledPromotionSize = function(){
				let splits = $(_cover).find('.percent').html().split(' ').length;
				let sizeToGrow = .8;
				if(splits > 2){
					sizeToGrow = .75;
				} else if(splits > 1){
					sizeToGrow = .5
				}
				if($(window).width() > 1360){
					sizeToGrow = .35;
					if(splits > 2){
						sizeToGrow = .5;
					} else if(splits > 1){
						sizeToGrow = .5
					}
				} else if($(window).width() > 1024){			
					sizeToGrow = .25;
					if(splits > 2){
						sizeToGrow = .45;
					} else if(splits > 1){
						sizeToGrow = .45
					}
				} else if($(window).width() > 768){			
					sizeToGrow = .35;
					if(splits > 2){
						sizeToGrow = .45;
					} else if(splits > 1){
						sizeToGrow = .45
					}
				}
				
				let aux = $('<div style="display: inline-block; font-size:30px; opacity:0; pointer-events: none;">'+$(_cover).find('.percent').html()+'</div>');
				$('body').append(aux);

				while (aux.width() < $(window).width() * sizeToGrow && $(_cover).find('.percent').html() != '') {
					let pix = parseInt($(aux).css('font-size').replace('px','')) + 2;
					$(aux).css('font-size', pix+'px');
					$(_cover).find('.percent').css('font-size', pix+'px');
				}

				aux.remove();
			}

			const throttledPromotion = _.throttle(throttledPromotionSize, 20);
			$(window).on('resize', throttledPromotion);
			
			aux.remove();
		},
		parseValue(value) {
			// objetos simulados desde CMS con separadores 
			if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length > 0 && value[0].indexOf(this.separador_OBJECT) !== -1) {
				let separador = this.separador_OBJECT;
				const obj = value.reduce(function(result, item) { 
					const parts = item.split(separador);
					result[parts[0]] = parts[1];
					return result;
				}, {});
				return obj
			}
			if (typeof value !== "string") return value;

			// obsoletos
			// objetos y arrays simulados desde el CMS con separadores 		
			// objeto: key€€value$$key€€value	(obsoleto)
			if (value.indexOf(this.separador_OBJECT) !== -1) {
				return Object.fromEntries(
				value.split(this.separador_ARRAY).map(p => p.split(this.separador_OBJECT))
				);
			}
			// array: a$$b$$c  (obsoleto)
			if (value.indexOf(this.separador_ARRAY) !== -1) {
				return value.split(this.separador_ARRAY);
			}
			return value;			

		},
		setObjectData: function(_data){

			let dataAux = _data;
			let newCoverProps = {};
			let objetosToAssign = []; 
			if (dataAux.props) {
				// procesar las propiedades que vienen como un objeto simulado, y los arrays 							
				for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(dataAux.props)) {
					let parsed = this.parseValue(value);
					if (parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
						objetosToAssign.push(parsed)
					} else {
						if(key == "categoryid" && parsed) {							
							if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) { parsed = [parsed] } // convertir categoryid en un array de 1 
							newCoverProps["url"] = [];
							parsed.forEach(function(_categoryId){ 
								if(isNaN(_categoryId)) {
									// /qrapps 
									newCoverProps["url"].push( _categoryId ); 
								}
								else {
									newCoverProps["url"].push( Inditex.generateUrl("ItxCategoryPage", { "categoryId": _categoryId, "storeId": Inditex.iStoreId, "langId": Inditex.iLangId, "catalogId": Inditex.iCatalogId }) ); 
								}
							})
						}						
						if(key == "buttontext" && parsed) { if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) { parsed = [parsed] } }						
						newCoverProps[key] = parsed;
					}
				}
				// las keys que vengan como objetos, añadirlas en la cover, pisando los campos que ya estuviesen en la cover
				objetosToAssign.forEach(function(_parsed) { Object.assign(newCoverProps, _parsed); })
				dataAux.props = newCoverProps;
			}
			dataAux.type = newCoverProps.type || "SIMPLE" ;
			dataAux.props.catTitle = (dataAux.props.title != null ? dataAux.props.title : '');	
			return dataAux;
		},
		setVideo: function(_data){
			let data = _data.propsJSON;
			let html = _data.elementHTML;
			let video =  data.video;
			let imageV =  data.image;
			let alt = _data.alt || "";
			
			$(html).find('.cover-media').empty();		

			if(inditex.isMobileDevice()){ 
				video = data.videoM; 
				imageV = data.imageM; 			
			}
			
			let posterHTML = '<img src="'+imageV+'" alt="'+alt+'" style="opacity: 1;" />';
			let videoHTML = '<video id="'+data.name+'-video" muted autoplay loop playsinline preload="none" data-src="'+video+'"></video>';

			$(html).find('.cover-media').append(posterHTML);
			$(html).find('.cover-media').append(videoHTML);
		},
		setTransparentVideo: function(_data){
			let data = _data.propsJSON;
			let html = _data.elementHTML;
			let video;
			let imageV =  data.image;
			let alt = _data.alt || "";
			
			$(html).find('.cover-media').empty();		

			// video transparente , diferente version para safari (videoiOS) que resto (videoAndroid)			
			let videoOrigin = data.videoAndroid ; 
			var isSafari = /^((?!chrome|chromium|crios|fxios|edg|opr|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
			if (isSafari) {
				videoOrigin = data.videoiOS; 
			}
			if(inditex.isMobileDevice() && videoOrigin.length > 1){ 
				video = videoOrigin[1]
				imageV = data.imageM; 			
			}
			else {
				video = videoOrigin[0]
			}
			
			let imageHTML = '<img src="'+imageV+'" alt="'+alt+'" style="opacity: 1;" />';
			let videoHTML = '<video id="'+data.name+'-video" muted autoplay loop playsinline preload="none" class="transparent" data-src="'+video+'"></video>';

			$(html).find('.cover-media').append(imageHTML);
			$(html).find('.cover-media').append(videoHTML);

			if (this.animObserver){ this.animObserver.observe(html[0]); }
		},		
		loadGender: function(_cat){
			this.$el.empty();
			this.initGender = _cat;

			this.initGender = this.initGender.concat("-2026");
			/*if(inditex.iXPublicVarsMap.cmsHomePageSuffix && inditex.iXPublicVarsMap.cmsHomePageSuffix != ''){
				this.initGender = this.initGender.concat(inditex.iXPublicVarsMap.cmsHomePageSuffix);
			}*/

			window.location.hash = '#' + this.initGender.split('-')[1];
			if(this.homesJSON[this.initGender] == null){
				this.getGenderTags(this.initGender);
			} else {
				inditex.iHomeJSON = this.genderData[this.initGender];
				this.createCovers(this.homesJSON[this.initGender]);
			}

			try{				
				inditex.LFGender.setGenderCookie();
				inditex.iXProductJSON.sectionNameEnOrigin = hardSectionName[this.initGender.split('-')[1]];
			} catch(e) {
				console.log(e);
			}
		},
		setAnalyticsData( _coverData, _extraInfo) {
			try {
				let extraInfo = _extraInfo || {}; 
				// cover doble info del bloque en gaBloqueIndex 
				if (_coverData.gaBloqueIndex) { extraInfo.bloque = _coverData.gaBloqueIndex }
				
				let type = _coverData.type; 
				if (!_coverData.name) { _coverData.name = type }
				type = type && type.toLowerCase() || "simple";

				let normalizeType = function(type) {
					const exactReplacements = { "double": "doble", "recommended": "recomendados", "sale": "rebajas", "sections": "secciones", "menu": "simple", "countdown":"simple" };
					const partialReplacements = [ { match: "promotion", replace: "promociones" }, { match: "banner", replace: "banner" }, { match: "inlefties", replace: "simple" } ];
					for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(exactReplacements)) { type = type.replace(key, value); }
					for (const rule of partialReplacements) { if (type.includes(rule.match)) { return rule.replace; } }
					return type;
				}
				let creative_slot = normalizeType(type);
				
				let promotion_name = _coverData.name;   // usar el nombre del elemento de la cover 
				promotion_name = promotion_name.split("_i_")[0]; promotion_name = promotion_name.split("_e_")[0];
				let creative_name = promotion_name;
				
				let promotion_id = _coverData.image || "home"; // usar el nombre de la imagen 
				promotion_id = promotion_id.substr(promotion_id.lastIndexOf("/")+ 1).split(".")[0];
				
				let im_discount = "no";  // obtener el descuento del percentage 
				let checkPercentage;
				if (_coverData.percentage) { checkPercentage = _coverData.percentage }
				else if (_coverData.title && _coverData.title.indexOf("%") != -1) { checkPercentage = _coverData.title }
				if (checkPercentage) {
					let discount = [];				
					let textos = checkPercentage.split("%");
					if (textos.length > 0) {
						for (var i = 0; i < textos.length; i++) {
							textos[i] = textos[i].replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
							if (textos[i].length > 0) { discount.push(textos[i] + "%") }
						}
						discount = discount.join("-");
						im_discount = discount || "si";
					}
				}
				
				let location_id = "modulo_" + this.gaInfo.pos + ( extraInfo.bloque ? ("|bloque_" + extraInfo.bloque) : "");
				if (inditex.isMobileDevice()) {
					location_id = "modulo_" + this.gaInfo.posM + ( extraInfo.bloqueM ? ("|bloque_" + extraInfo.bloqueM) : "");
				}			

				let _infoGA4 = {
					creative_name: creative_name,
					creative_slot: creative_slot,
					promotion_name : promotion_name,
					promotion_id: promotion_id,
					im_discount: im_discount,
					location_id: location_id				
				}					
				this.gaInfo[_coverData.type + "_" + _coverData.name] = _infoGA4;
				// añadir im_link_type categoryId y menuType para el click 'select_promotion'
				return _infoGA4; 
			}
			catch(e){ console.error("setAnalyticsData",e)}
			
		}	

	});

	try{

	/* HARDCODEO SECTION NAME */
	inditex.iXProductJSON = { "sectionNameEnOrigin": '' };	

	inditex.iXHomeView = new inditex.iXViews.homeCovers();
	inditex.iXHomeView.getGenderTags(inditex.iXHomeView.initGender);

	inditex.onReady(function(){
		if(inditex.iXHomeView.genderData[inditex.iXHomeView.initGender] != null && inditex.iXHomeView.firstTime){
			inditex.iXHomeView.render();
			inditex.iXHomeView.firstTime = false;
		}
		inditex.iXHomeView.onReady = true;

		$('#layout_content').append(inditex.iXHomeView.$el);
		$('html').addClass('home-menu');
	});
} catch(e){
	console.log(e);
}

/* animacion navidad nieve */
.snow-image {
    overflow: hidden;
}

.snow-image .cover-media {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.snowflake {
    position: absolute;
    top: -20px;
    color: #fff;
    line-height: 1;
    opacity: 0.85;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: snow-fall linear forwards;
}

@keyframes snow-fall {
    0% {
        top: -20px;
        transform: translateX(0) rotate(0deg);
    }

    25% {
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-1)) rotate(90deg);
    }

    50% {
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-2)) rotate(180deg);
    }

    75% {
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-1)) rotate(270deg);
    }

    100% {
        top: 110%;
        transform: translateX(var(--snow-x-2)) rotate(360deg);
    }
}
/* animacion navidad nieve */

/* video nieve transparente */
.lft-cover .cover-media video.transparent {
    bottom:0;
    right:0;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover; 
    opacity:0;
    transform: scale(0.98);
    transition: opacity 0.75s ease, transform 0.75s ease;    
}

.lft-cover .cover-media video.transparent:hover {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
}

    opacity:0;
    transform: scale(1);
    transition: opacity 0.75s ease, transform 0.75s ease;    
}

  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
}

var LFGender = new Class({

	initialize: function() {
		this.setGenderCookie();
	},
	setGenderCookie: function() {
		if (inditex.iPage == "ItxHomePage" && ["#woman", "#man", "#kids", "#girl", "#boy", "#hogar"].contains(window.location.hash)) {
			var gender = window.location.hash.split("#")[1];
			if (!["woman", "man", "kids", "hogar"].contains(gender)) {
				gender = "woman";
			}
			Cookie.write("LFGenderSelection", gender, {
				duration: 365
			});
		} else if (
			inditex.LFCategoryTreeUtil.cookieCategories.contains(inditex.iCategoryId) || //its a magazine home page
			inditex.iPage == "ItxCategoryPage" || //is a products category page
			(document.getElementsByTagName('html')[0].id == "productPage" && Cookie.read('LFGenderSelection') == null) //its a product page

		) {
			this.setPBGenderCookieBasedOnMainCategory();
		}
	},
	setPBGenderCookieBasedOnMainCategory: function() {
		var mainCategoryForThisPage = inditex.LFPlatformUtils.getCurrentCategoryByLevel(0);
		if (mainCategoryForThisPage != null && inditex.LFCategoryTreeUtil.cookieCategories.contains(mainCategoryForThisPage.id) && inditex.LFCategoryTreeUtil.getMainCategoryGender(mainCategoryForThisPage.id) != "") {
			Cookie.write("LFGenderSelection", inditex.LFCategoryTreeUtil.getMainCategoryGender(mainCategoryForThisPage.id), {
				duration: 365
			});
		}
	}
});

/********************* END LFGender.js *********************/





/********************* START LFCategoryTreeUtil.js *********************/

var LFCategoryTreeUtil = new Class({
	map: null,
	cookieCategories: [],

	initialize: function() {
		this.map = {
			"1030267502": "woman",
			"1030267562": "man",
			"1030496541": "teen",
			"1030651593": "hogar",
			"1030267671": "kids"
		};
		this.cookieCategories = [1030267502, 1030267562, 1030496541, 1030267671, 1030651593];
		this.preprocessCategoryTree();
		this.preprocessCategorySales();
		this.setDescriptionObject(inditex.iCategoryTreeJSON)
	},
	preprocessCategoryTree: function() {
		//remove categories
		if (inditex.iCategoryId == null) inditex.iCategoryId = "0";
		var hiddenCategories = [1172002, 1030177002, 1030185003];
		this.removeCategories(inditex.iCategoryTreeJSON, hiddenCategories);
		this.cleanCategories(inditex.iCategoryTreeJSON);
	},
	removeCategories: function(tree, hidden) {
		var subcategories = tree.hasOwnProperty("subcategories") ? "subcategories" : "categories";
		tree[subcategories].each(function(item, index) {
			if (hidden.indexOf(item.id) > -1) {
				tree[subcategories][index] = null;
			} else if (item.hasOwnProperty("subcategories") && item.subcategories.length > 0) {
				this.removeCategories(tree[subcategories][index], hidden);
			}
		}.bind(this));
	},
	cleanCategories: function(tree) {
		var subcategories = tree.hasOwnProperty("subcategories") ? "subcategories" : "categories";
		tree[subcategories].each(function(item, index) {
			if (item != null && item.hasOwnProperty("subcategories") && item.subcategories.length > 0) {
				this.cleanCategories(tree[subcategories][index]);
			}
		}.bind(this));
		tree[subcategories] = tree[subcategories].clean();
	},
	getMobileCategoryHeaders: function() {
		return [1030267502, 1030267562, 1030267671];
	},
	getMainCategoryGender: function(_id) {

		if (this.map.hasOwnProperty(_id))
			return this.map[_id];
		else
			return "";
	},
	setDescriptionObject: function(cat) {
		var subcats = cat.hasOwnProperty("categories") ? "categories" : "subcategories";
		cat[subcats].each(function(category, index) {
			try {
				if (cat[subcats][index].hasOwnProperty("description")) {
					if (cat[subcats][index].id != 0o1) {
						cat[subcats][index].description = JSON.decode(cat[subcats][index].description);
					}
					if (cat[subcats][index].description == null) {
						cat[subcats][index].description = {};
					}
					if (category.subcategories.length > 0) {
						this.setDescriptionObject(category);
					}
				} else {
					cat[subcats][index]["description"] = {};
				}
			} catch (err) {

				cat[subcats][index]["description"] = {};
				if (category.subcategories.length > 0) {
					this.setDescriptionObject(category);
				}
			}
		}.bind(this));
	},
	preprocessCategorySales: function() {
		//FIX INICIO REBAJAS
		var dateRebajas = new LFDate();
		if ("undefined" != typeof SalesConfiguratorJSON && SalesConfiguratorJSON.hasOwnProperty("activateSales")) {

		}

		//inditex.iStoreJSON.details.visibleBookings = false;
		//inditex.iStoreJSON.details.availabilityStockStore = false;
		if (window.location && window.location.hash != undefined && window.location.hash == "#clickcollect") {
			//inditex.iStoreJSON.details.visibleBookings = "SHOW";

    const actions = productIds.map(id => {
      const params = {
        storeId: inditex.iStoreId,
        catalogId: inditex.iCatalogId,
        productIds: String(id),
        languageId: inditex.iLangId,

        params.allowWithoutStock = true;

        params.allowWithoutStock = false;
      }

      if (categoryId) {
        params.categoryId = categoryId;
      }

      return {
        action: 'GET_CATALOG_PRODUCTS_ESI',
        params
      };
    });

    // allSettled => nunca rechaza por fallo de una de las peticiones
    return Promise.allSettled(
      actions.map(action => inditex.xRestExecute([action]))
    ).then(results => {
      const allProducts = [];

      results.forEach((result, index) => {

          const data = result.value;
          if (data && data[0] && Array.isArray(data[0].products)) {
            allProducts.push(...data[0].products);

        } else {

          console.error('Error obteniendo producto', productIds[index], result.reason);
        }
      });

      return allProducts;
